notes.title: New game "Your Lover" is launched
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45456002/9a5e01ba2c4ea6c84bcbede20cad54a92b4225a8.jpg[/img]
"Your Lover" is a 3D desktop pet.

Its main features include explosive dances,

3D dynamic clothing,

And it can listen to your computer's audio to create real-time special effect feedback.

It's especially crazy and exciting.

Additionally, thanks to the development team's efforts, it now supports the Steam Workshop.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3584390]Portal[/url]

notes.title: February 26 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Today we updated the DLC interface. Currently, two DLC packs have been implemented and are available online. Thank you for your support!
They include adorable pandas, koalas, and foxes.
Six other DLC interfaces are visible but still in the review process. We'll notify you as soon as they pass the review!

Additionally, we've added completion animations! Now you'll see an animation when you complete the puzzle.
After completion, you'll remain on the puzzle screen and need to manually return, considering that players might want to take screenshots.
If you have any questions, please feel free to leave a message in the discussion section!

Thank you!
